# Tines: Workflow Orchestration Platform Analysis

Citation-backed research on Tines — evaluating it as a workflow engine for
a personal AI-assisted engineering assistant that orchestrates CLI tools on
a single Fedora workstation.

## TL;DR

Tines is a proprietary, closed-source workflow automation platform built
for enterprise security operations (SOAR). Founded 2018 in Dublin, $1.125B
valuation, $272M raised. **Not viable for the personal PA use case:**
self-hosting requires paid Business/Enterprise tier, CLI execution requires
a workaround not on the free tier, and the Community Edition limits
(3 flows, 25K events/month, cloud-only) are below minimum requirements.
n8n is strictly superior on every critical dimension.

## Requirements vs Tines

| # | Requirement | Tines Support | Verdict |
|---|-------------|---------------|---------|
| 1 | Shell/CLI execution | Command-over-HTTP only (paid/self-hosted) | **Blocked** |
| 2 | Credential isolation | CREDENTIAL formula, MCP isolation | **Strong** |
| 3 | Self-hosted, single workstation | Business/Enterprise only ($sales) | **Blocked** |
| 4 | REST API management | Full CRUD, 5000 req/min | Pass |
| 5 | Cron scheduling | Cron expressions, 1-min minimum | Pass |
| 6 | Execution history | Per-step inspection, 24h retention (free) | Weak |
| 7 | Retry/error handling | Exponential backoff (HTTP only) | Partial |
| 8 | Webhook triggers | HMAC signing, OAuth, rate limiting | Pass |
| 9 | OSI license | Proprietary, closed-source | **Fail** |
| 10 | AI/LLM integration | AI Agent, BYOLLM, MCP client+server | Pass |

## Quick Comparison: Tines vs n8n

| Feature | Tines | n8n |
|---------|-------|-----|
| License | Proprietary | Sustainable Use (source-available) |
| Self-hosting (free) | No | Yes |
| CLI execution | Workaround (paid) | Native Execute Command |
| Free tier flows | 3 | Unlimited (self-hosted) |
| Pre-built integrations | HTTP-native | 400+ nodes |
| AI nodes | 1 (AI Agent) | 70+ (LangChain) |
| GitHub stars | <20/repo | 150K+ |
| Cloud entry price | $500/mo | $24/mo |

## Decision

**Skip Tines.** Continue with n8n for the PA workflow engine evaluation.

Tines is the right tool for enterprise SOC teams running security playbooks
at scale — but the personal PA needs free self-hosting, native CLI execution,
and unlimited workflow capacity, none of which Tines provides.
